data.narrative:
Zettascale is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Elias Almqvist (CEO) and Prithvi Raj (CTO), having raised $3M+ to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector contains 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, SambaNova Systems, and Etched, though only 2 adjacent-stage private peers are available, insufficient for a reliable peer-median approach.

Given data constraints, stage-progression anchoring is the primary applicable method. Using total raised ($3M) as a proxy for Seed valuation and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $7.5M. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied because target revenue is not disclosed—a typical limitation for private companies. The Semiconductors peer set trades at a 20.4x median P/S across the three public comps, but without Zettascale's revenue, this multiple cannot be operationalized.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6M to $9M, with a median point of $8M. This range reflects downside ($6M) and upside ($9M) scenarios around the stage-progression midpoint, accounting for execution risk and data sparsity. Key uncertainties include the absence of comparable private financings at identical stage and product maturity, lack of revenue visibility, and reliance on a single valuation method. Revenue traction or follow-on funding terms would materially refine this range.
